title: The Scrap Heap
text: A hill of broken arms and armor, rusted swords and split shields and helms with the heads still in them. A tinker squats on top, grinning. The one carrying least may take the most, he says. Those are the rules of the heap.

options.label: The one with the most room in their pack climbs the heap, as the rules allow.

outcomes.text: They come down loaded, and do not look at the helms.

options.label: The most armored climbs it anyway. Rules are for tinkers.

outcomes.text: The heap slides, and takes their legs with it.
They find the tinker's own good hammer, buried deep.

options.label: Trade with the tinker for parts, and leave the heap to him.

outcomes.text: Fair weight for fair coin. He grins the whole time.
